_note: Lap 4001 oracle fixture (sqlparse #842). kind=paging_clause cases are property-based: the clause must stay on one line, nothing may be dropped, and the lines before the clause may not move. kind=exact_lines cases are controls whose base output IS the expected output (P2P regression guards). Every expected output below was measured on the pinned base 60cdc649; the paging cases were additionally measured GREEN at base+gold (PR #855 source hunk) and at a 1-line alternative fix.
